name: War-Awoken Lunarian Hope (Weapon Skill)
effects:
Single-target Holy/NE piercing white magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & 30% DEF/RES Pierce to Holy Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least 0/40% Imperil Holy
WS Blue: Imperil Holy 30% to all enemies
WS Gold: DeShell 20% to all enemies
